_meta._owner: batch-2 / 后端目录英文事实源
_meta._what: 目录数据的英文事实源（I18N_CONTRACT D4）：任务类型 / 评审模式 / 技能 / 人格包 / 包分类。
_meta._how: app/i18n/catalog_en.py 在 import 期把这里的值查表合并成同级键 name_en / description_en / stance_labels_en / category_name_en。端点签名一个字不改：没有 lang 参数，没有 Accept-Language 分支。
_meta._assert: 下面每一节的 id 集必须与中文源逐一对应，缺一个后端启动即失败（catalog_en.assert_catalog_en_complete）。这是让「缺译」变成可发现失败、而不是静默显示中文的唯一机械保证。
_meta._never_translate: stance_enum / score_dimensions / 一切 id 都是聚类键与 wire contract，永不翻译。stance_labels 只是显示层，逐位对应 stance_enum，位置即契约——顺序错了等于把「会买」显示成「不买」。
_meta._persona_identity: 人格身份不本地化（I18N_CONTRACT 10.3）：张伟在英文模式下仍叫张伟。本文件只覆盖目录，不覆盖 src/personas/*.yaml 里的人格档案。
_meta._review_mode_names: 模式名（Quick / Standard / Full）的 owner 是前端 enum.mode_badge——后端 REVIEW_MODES 压根没有 name 字段，这里再给一份就是给同一个词立第二个 owner。所以本节只发 description。
_meta._pack_names: 人格包的 name 用受众群体的叫法（『Core Gamers』而不是『Game Core Persona Pack』），与前端 catalog.persona_pack.ts 逐字一致，免得同一个包在两个页面显示两个英文名。
_meta._pack_category_desc: 包分类的描述文案（『按玩家特征分类』等）住在前端 mock-data.ts 的 PACK_CATEGORIES，后端从来不发它，所以这里只给分类标题、不给分类描述——给了就是给同一句话立第二个 owner。

competitive-esport.name: Competitive Esports Players
competitive-esport.description: Competitive and esports pack covering five players: the ranked climber, the speedrunner, the team coordinator, the spectator, and the mod-scene competitor. Use it to judge competitive depth, matchmaking, spectator systems, and community tooling.

family-casual.name: Family & Casual Players
family-casual.description: Family and casual pack covering five players: parent-and-child co-play, party socializing, unwinding, retro nostalgia, and the cross-generation bridge. Use it to judge family fit, local multiplayer, stress relief, and universal design.

indie-creative.name: Indie Creatives
indie-creative.description: Indie and experimental-play pack covering five players: the indie connoisseur, the novelty seeker, the cultural consumer, the narrative designer, and the rhythm-game player. Use it to review creative depth, artistic voice, narrative structure, and mechanical invention.

mobile-f2p.name: Mobile F2P Players
mobile-f2p.description: Mobile and free-to-play pack covering five players: the whale, the never-pays, the socially driven, the anime fan, and the hyper-casual player. Use it to review monetization, social features, retention, and short-session design in mobile and F2P products.

vr-immersive.name: VR Immersion Seekers
vr-immersive.description: VR and immersive pack covering four players: the motion-sickness prone, the immersion seeker, the fitness player, and the social VR user. Use it to review comfort, presence, physical movement, and social space in VR and XR products.

accessibility.name: Accessibility Advocates
accessibility.description: Accessibility pack covering four players: color vision deficiency, cognitive load, motor impairment, and hearing impairment. Use it to review how complete and how usable a game's accessibility design really is.

educational-serious.name: Educational & Serious Games
educational-serious.description: Educational and serious-games pack covering four players: the teacher evaluating, the parent gatekeeping, the lifelong learner, and the learner with special educational needs. Use it to review learning-goal alignment, content safety, progress tracking, and accessibility.

launch-compliance.name: Launch Blockers
launch-compliance.description: The launch-blocker pack. This product sells finding risk before you ship, yet every earlier persona was a player or an investor, and none of them stood for the roles that can actually keep a product off the shelf: platform submission, ratings and licensing, privacy compliance, device coverage, and the refunding or churned users who already voted with their feet. This pack adds those five. They do not answer whether it is fun. They answer whether it can ship, whether it gets sent back, and whether a refund wave follows.

general-consumer.name: General Consumers
general-consumer.description: A general product and user pack, not games only: multi-angle user views for product feedback, pricing pages, onboarding, and similar everyday scenarios.

startup-panel.name: Startup Review Panel
startup-panel.description: A startup review panel of investors, diligence analysts, and incubator screeners, for reviewing decks, pitch material, and application forms in any industry.
